results.title: Understudy
results.overview: An ambitious young theater assistant grows frustrated as his ideas are repeatedly dismissed by the director of a troubled production of Macbeth. Determined to prove his creative worth, he begins pushing his own vision behind the scenes, setting off a power struggle that blurs the line between artistic conviction and personal ambition.

results.title: Let's Make Noise
results.overview: When the government tries to take away women’s right to vote, Stella joins forces with Carlotta and Marco to raise awareness. In doing so, she meets Prof. Zanetti, once an inspiring woman, now embittered after a life of lost battles.

results.title: Tuklas
results.overview: The first Bisaya VMX Original stars true-blooded Bisaya Skye Gonzaga. When IT officer Chris Alvarado uncovers a financial scandal at work, he faces a moral dilemma: exposing the truth or giving in to Anna, a seductive sales manager promising success and intimacy.

results.title: Generations: The Evolution of Spider-Man
results.overview: Swing through twenty years of Spider-Man history—from Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield to Tom Holland. Explore the evolution of the iconic suits and stunts, follow Tom's journey into the mask, and get an exclusive look at Peter Parker's next chapter with Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton.

results.title: Mrithyunjay
results.overview: An intense murder investigation unfolds when a man refuses to accept a death casually deemed natural by the police. As he digs deeper, what begins as doubt turns into a relentless pursuit of truth, uncovering layers of deception and danger

results.title: Four Birds
results.overview: A falsely accused and convicted man is released from prison and pushed back into his community where he's in conflict over drugs, love, and violence after changing his life.

results.title: Eixam
results.overview: Having lost everything, Lluc arrives in Malpàs and is welcomed into an isolated community that seems to promise a fresh start. As his bond with Silvia deepens and the village’s harmony begins to crack, Lluc must reckon with the unsettling boundary between finding a home and surrendering his freedom.

results.title: The Nameless Ballad
results.overview: Under pressure from his record label, a young musician in crisis takes refuge in an isolated Italian villa to find inspiration for his next album. But the discovery of an ancient piano and a forgotten diary drags him into a spiral of twisted obsessions, supernatural visions and ghostly presences that finally push him to the brink of madness.

results.title: A Season to Blossom
results.overview: An aspiring writer takes over her late grandmother's bookstore and finds love.

results.title: Bulk
results.overview: When an over zealous scientist pushes his experiments with string theory too far, his brane explodes. That's "brane", not "brain", meaning someone has to sort out the mess he has created. Corey Harlan is sent in – kicking and screaming – to find the heart of the brane and its creator.

results.title: NJPW Road to The New Beginning 2026 - Day 8
results.original_title: NJPW Road to The New Beginning 2026 - Day 8
results.overview: The eighth night of Road to The New Beginning 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on February 4, 2026, at Toyota Crown Arena in Fukushima, Japan.

results.title: Wake
results.overview: After committing murder and disposing of the evidence, Ellie (Natasha Lockhart) seeks help in therapy following the tragic event in hope it destroys the sound, pain and fear she has since experienced. The mind is a powerful thing and her own...Let's say it has a mind of its own. Wake marks Leon's debut as an independent writer and director!'  Starring: Natasha Lockhart

results.title: Spring Wind - The Awakening
results.overview: Follows the birth of a political and social movement from the inside, with Péter Magyar as its face. For more than a year, the filmmakers accompanied him on country tours, campaign sites, and background conversations, as well as being present in those quiet, intimate moments – many times in his own home – that have remained hidden from the public until now.

results.title: The Land of Sometimes
results.overview: Twins Alfie and Elise find a magical Wish Watch on Christmas Eve and are swept by the Wish Collector into the musical Land of Sometimes, where they learn that wishes have consequences.

results.title: Preschool
results.overview: Two determined fathers engage in a comical battle to enroll their kids in an elite preschool, escalating into an absurd competition with unexpected results.

results.title: Baśka
results.overview: Baska runs a catering company from home. In addition, she takes care of three children and takes care of her husband, Kacper, who constantly works overtime in the office. Somewhere she lost her spark and zest for life. When she meets the handsome and famous choreographer Jim at work, her life turns upside down. Jim helps Baska gain new clients and her business flourishes. Baska is also blooming. However, her home life suffers. In addition, Kacper begins to suspect Baska of having an affair and demands a divorce. Baska must decide whether she wants to start her life anew or return to what she has built over the years.

results.title: FOUFO
results.overview: The encounter of Madurese residents with small aliens that triggers hilarious chaos and unexpected adventures.

results.title: El conseguidor
results.overview: In a changing political landscape marked by corruption in Spain, a "fixer"—an intermediary for political contracts—finds himself trapped between an unscrupulous businessman and a politician trying to escape his illegal dealings. Struggling to keep his personal life afloat, he must walk a dangerous tightrope to save his own life.

results.title: Louis Theroux: Inside the Manosphere
results.overview: With rare access and no holds barred, the acclaimed documentarian investigates a growing ultra-masculine network and its controversial influencers.
